question: Can the expressed meaning ever stand apart from the expressing word?
premises: One might object that the expressed stands apart from the expresser.
By its autonomy the expresser alone appears as what will be expressed.
Therefore the expressed does not exist as a separate independent entity.
inference: The expressed meaning never stands apart from the expresser, because the autonomous expresser itself appears as the future expressed.
plain_english: And it should not be said that the expressed ever stands apart from the expresser; for by autonomy the expresser alone appears as what will be expressed.
